ValidationRule.description: An accounting System Site cannot be linked to a Framework Agreement or a Master Service Agreement
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Global Delegated Admin' && $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User' &&( ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contract__r.Type__c, 'Framework Agreement') || ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contract__r.Type__c, 'Master Service Agreement'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An accounting System Site cannot be linked to a Framework Agreement or a Master Service Agreement
